context_notes: THE ONE STRUCTURAL LESSON OF THIS SESSION: prose acceptance criteria let the author grade their own work, and in this repo the author was wrong every single time. Three patching rounds, three fresh defects -- a false 'understated by 250 chars' when it OVERSTATED, a '1508 was over-cap' when 1508 is UNDER the 1536 cap, and a double-space bug in the fold repair that inflated every measured length. Each was caught by a plan-checker, an unprimed reviewer, or a selftest leg. Wave 1 exists to end that: the criteria are executable now. TRUST THE SUITE OVER YOUR READING. SECOND LESSON, which cost two false GREENs today: a mutation you did not verify LANDED is not a test -- these files hard-wrap near 100 columns so any multi-line anchor silently fails to match, and a pipeline's exit code is the LAST stage's, so `rg pattern file | head` reports head's status. Check exit codes directly: 0 hits, 1 genuine absence, 2 the command FAILED and tells you nothing. THIRD: `git grep` is case-sensitive; a documentation check reported text missing today when it was present. FOURTH, on scope: two unprimed reviews have now confirmed the SHIPPED routing text is correct at both tiers on all nine corpus cases, so everything remaining buys protection against FUTURE regression, not correctness today -- if the owner would rather close the milestone, stopping here is defensible and the suite preserves the backlog exactly.
